svg.title: Irha Construction — project card
svg.desc: A scroll-driven website where a 3D excavator drives you through a live construction site: the gate, the cranes, the material yard and a finished tower. Built with React, Three.Js, Gsap, Framer. Live demo. Banner: the game's real title screen.
svg.text: A scroll-driven website where a 3D excavator drives you through a live
construction site: the gate, the cranes, the material yard and a finished tower.
